# cdnpro_deployment (Resource)

Deploys (or removes) property and certificate versions to staging or production. Before a `deploy_property` action the provider validates the version if needed. On create, actions whose desired state already matches the live deployment are skipped, which is how an existing deployment is adopted. Destroying a resource with `deploy_*` actions removes those versions from the target; `remove_*` actions are not reversed. Import is not supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Staging always tracks the newest property version.
resource "cdnpro_deployment" "staging" {
  target = "staging"

  actions = [
    {
      action      = "deploy_property"
      property_id = cdnpro_property.main.id
      version     = cdnpro_property.main.latest_version
    },
    {
      action         = "deploy_cert"
      certificate_id = cdnpro_certificate.prod.id
      version        = cdnpro_certificate.prod.latest_version
    },
  ]
}

# Production is pinned to a version that is bumped by hand once staging has
# been verified, which turns promotion into a separate, human-gated apply.
variable "production_property_version" {
  type        = number
  description = "Property version promoted to production."
}

resource "cdnpro_deployment" "production" {
  target = "production"

  actions = [
    {
      action      = "deploy_property"
      property_id = cdnpro_property.main.id
      version     = var.production_property_version
    },
    {
      action         = "deploy_cert"
      certificate_id = cdnpro_certificate.prod.id
      version        = cdnpro_certificate.prod.latest_version
    },
  ]

  # Never let two deployments race the same environment (DuplicateDeployment).
  depends_on = [cdnpro_deployment.staging]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `target` (String)

### Optional

- `name` (String) Label for the deployment task. Defaults to a generated name.
- `webhook` (String) Webhook ID notified when the deployment task finishes.

### Read-Only

- `finish_time` (String)
- `id` (String) Stable identifier: the first deployment task submitted, or an `adopted:` marker when the live state already matched on create.
- `status` (String)
- `status_details` (String)
- `submission_time` (String)
- `task_id` (String) ID of the most recent deployment task submitted by this resource, empty when none was needed.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `action` (String)

Optional:

- `certificate_id` (String)
- `property_id` (String)
- `version` (Number) Version to deploy. Required for `deploy_*` actions; typically `cdnpro_property.x.latest_version`, or a pinned number to roll back. For `remove_*` actions the provider records the version it found deployed out of band so the next plan shows the drift.
